source: Yahoo Finance chart API (query1.finance.yahoo.com), retrieved 2026-10-25. Nasdaq-100 underlying prices are ^NDX split-adjusted index closes. The QQQ sleeve is QQQ dividend-adjusted close so the 1x position includes dividends. The semiconductor series is the PHLX Semiconductor Index (^SOX) close, used both as the underlying for the synthetic 3x fund and as the 1x sleeve, because SOXX did not exist for all of 1999-2012. The VTI benchmark is a chained total-return index: VTSMX adjusted-close returns until 2001-06-15 (VTI's first bar in this Yahoo history; VTI listed on 2001-05-24), then VTI adjusted-close returns. VTSMX is the mutual-fund share class of the same Vanguard total US market portfolio. Synthetic 3x prices are not stored; they are built in the engine as a daily-reset 3x of the underlying close with a 0.90% yearly expense subtracted on each trading day (expense/252) and a floor at zero.
